{{Top|leg}}
'''Hazmat droids''' were a specialized type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that operated during hazardous situations and environments. Often they would be seen operating along with [[Rescue droid/Legends|rescue droids]] and [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], activated by automatic emergency response systems.

==History==
Hazmat droids were part of automatic emergency response systems of some installations around [[The galaxy/Legends|the Galaxy]], such as on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] the ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'' piloted by [[Jan Ors]] destroyed a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bomber]] at a tower near [[Launch Deck Three]] of Nar Shaddaa. The explosion triggered automatic alarms and systems, such as wall-mounted foam nozzles. Rescue, medical and hazmat droids moved towards the TIE's debris.<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
As the name suggests, these droids were specialized in handling hazardous material ([[Wiktionary:hazmat|hazmat]]).
